items.caption: A modern drawing labeled as the Shuowen seal-script form of 午. Paleographic accounts interpret the graph as a pestle and describe its lower end becoming a horizontal stroke in seal script; this drawing illustrates that source interpretation, not an ancient artifact.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style form of 午 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: Useful as a labeled seal-script example that accompanies the reported graphic change, while its modern redraw status and the interpretive nature of the pestle reading remain clear.

limitations.text: The proposed pestle shape and its transformation are paleographic interpretations; the pictured seal form is a modern redraw, not an inscribed artifact. The ancient implement’s name and pronunciation remain unknown, so the proposed sound basis for borrowing 午 as the earthly-branch sign cannot be verified.
